verdict.rationale: New Relic has a public pricing page with a perpetual free tier that includes 100 GB/month of data ingest, so some self-serve cost information exists without contacting sales. The evidence shows no published per-GB overage rates, per-user rates, or per-signal breakdown. Community reports say pricing is baffling (environments billed as extra production), costs jumped sharply under per-user billing, and default changes such as JFR multiplied ingest unexpectedly, all of which undercut cost predictability. Missing for 10: published per-GB and per-user rates, a per-signal pricing breakdown, a cost calculator or estimation docs, and independent confirmation that bills can be predicted from the published pricing.
